summary: Parkevtate Vosianc updates Coca-Cola after a third quarter he calls spectacular: revenue up 7% and, more impressively, unit case volume up 5%, showing people buying more units rather than just paying higher prices. Management raised 2026 guidance to at least 5% revenue growth and at least 9% EPS growth, with at least $13B of free cash flow, and the shares are up at least 31.6% year to date. He has rated Coke an excellent buying opportunity all year and reiterates that high-conviction ranking even after the run, with a DCF fair value revised higher to $96 against a price near $92. His own EPS growth estimate of 8-9% over the next several years sits above the Street's 7.4%. Beyond the numbers he stresses away-from-home momentum, restaurants, theme parks and cinemas, plus the KFC exclusive win taken from Pepsi, starting in 2027. The bear case is valuation: the forward P/E has run from about 20 to about 26, ahead of earnings, and a consumer-spending pullback on tariffs and stretched budgets would hit the business. Call: KO BUY reiterated, no flip. Note: the caption file ends mid-sentence.
